title: KM-Bus master TX: Vitotrol discovery poll evidence
source_note: Physical RAM 0x1600/32 + 0x1620/32, serialized P300 reads; frame begins at 0x161A, not a wire tap.
public_protocol_source_family: V200KW2 (not WB2A); class/slot semantics are analogical unless confirmed on WB2A

other_source_matched_tx.type: class 0x20, slot 0xEE, write N registers via B3
other_source_matched_tx.warning: Older V200KW2 documentation suspects 0x20/EE internally connected; not confirmed for local device.

next_gate: Trace UART1 receiver/participant discovery state via static controller firmware or schematic before any narrowly bounded, reviewed read-only RAM experiment.
limitations: These are sampled RAM TX buffer contents, not counts of complete physical bus transfers.
Two adjacent valid samples can be one retained frame; 39 nonconsecutive episodes are not 39 verified bus transmissions.
Source class 0x00 and CMD 0x33/F8/04 support controller master polling a Vitotrol-family identity; no receive frames collected.
Vitotrol class 0x11 TX poll does not prove a Vitotrol peripheral is connected or responding.
No separate GFA P06 blower actual-speed RX source has been identified.
